headline: WHITE HOUSE BLINKS: Copper Tariff Plan Stalls, Prices Crash 5.4% from Record Highs
snippet: Sources say the White House has shelved its refined copper tariff plan amid affordability concerns ahead of midterms, triggering a single-session 5.4% price collapse from the record $6.89/lb set a day earlier. Freeport-McMoRan and Teck Resources led copper producers down 7% as traders unwound tariff-premium positions built up over four consecutive record-setting sessions.

headline: PPI SPIKES TO 5.4%: Silver Loses 4.1%, Gold Slides as Fed Hike Odds Surge to 70%
snippet: August's annual producer price index came in at 5.4% — the highest reading of 2026 — sending September Fed rate-hike odds to 70% and hammering precious metals, with silver underperforming gold by nearly 3x as the gold-silver ratio jumped to 67.2 within an hour. The selloff sets up Friday's CPI report as the next make-or-break data point for the metals complex ahead of the September 16 Fed meeting.

headline: SECTOR RECORD: Mining Stocks Claim 60% of 2026 TSX30 as Gold and Critical Minerals Lead
snippet: For the first time, miners captured 18 of 30 spots on the Toronto Stock Exchange's annual top-performer list, led by Montage Gold's 2,502% three-year dividend-adjusted return and Faraday Copper's 688% gain. The wider commodity mix — adding copper, rare earths and other critical minerals alongside gold and silver — signals a structural broadening of the sector rally beyond just precious metals.

headline: FOUNDERS METALS HITS 27m of 20.38 g/t Au in First Step-Out on New West Zone, Suriname
snippet: Founders Metals (TSXV: FDR) released the first step-out results from the West Zone at its Antino Gold Project in Suriname: 27.0 metres grading 20.38 g/t gold, including a 10m interval at 43.26 g/t — among the widest, highest-grade results reported in the region this year. The West Zone sits 1.2 km from the established Froyo Zone, opening a new mineralized corridor with discovery hole FR217 having already returned 53.1m at 1.21 g/t from surface.

headline: BC GOLDEN TRIANGLE: Goliath Resources Opens New Wedge Zone, 14.28 g/t Au Over 4.3m
snippet: Goliath Resources (TSXV: GOT) confirmed a new Volcanic Wedge Zone at its Golddigger Property in BC's Golden Triangle, connecting the Bonanza and Golden Gate zones with a 4.32m interval grading 14.28 g/t gold including 2.30m at 26.80 g/t. The zone remains open for expansion, extending the strike of the continuously drilled mineralized system.

headline: URANIUM HOLDS $90: Kazatomprom's 10% Production Cut Removes 8 Million Lbs from 2026 Supply
snippet: Spot uranium held near a six-month high of $90/lb after Kazatomprom cut its 2026 nominal production target by 10% to 29,697 tonnes, removing roughly 8 million pounds of primary supply as sulphuric acid plant delays limit leaching capacity. Offer bands have shifted to $86–$90/lb for new long-term contracts, with utilities and data-centre developers increasingly financing Western mine development to reduce Kazakh dependence.

headline: 60-DAY WARNING: China's Rare Earth Control Wave Hits Nov. 10 — 5 Heavy Elements Enter Licensing
snippet: A one-year suspension of China's rare earth export controls — covering holmium, erbium, thulium, europium and ytterbium — expires November 10, 2026, triggering a 45-day licensing regime for exports of these specialty elements critical for lasers, nuclear components and advanced optics. Western processors and defence contractors have roughly 60 days to secure inventory or lock in supply agreements before the new regime takes effect.

headline: SILVER'S SIXTH STRAIGHT DEFICIT: 67 Million Oz Gap Widens as Solar and EVs Drain Stockpiles
snippet: The silver market is projected to run its sixth consecutive structural deficit in 2026 at an estimated 67 million ounces, as industrial demand from solar manufacturing and EVs continues to outpace mine supply growth. Cumulative drawdowns on above-ground stockpiles since 2021 now exceed 762 million troy ounces — a pace analysts describe as unsustainable without price rationing.

headline: GOLD STOCKS' AUTUMN WINDOW: Seasonal Pattern Points to 20-30% Rally — Junior Miners Lead
snippet: Adam Hamilton at GoldSeek lays out the seasonal case for gold miners surging 20–30% from early September through late September, with GDX recently breaking above key trendline resistance and GDXJ posting a 22% gain in a five-day breakout sprint. Thursday's PPI-driven selloff is viewed as a potential buying opportunity within the larger autumn seasonal window rather than a trend reversal.

headline: LITHIUM DOUBLES From 2025 Lows as Grid Storage Jumps 55% — But North American EV Sales Sink 25%
snippet: Battery-grade lithium carbonate has climbed from roughly $8/kg in May 2025 to over $25/kg, driven by a 55% surge in grid-scale energy storage demand — yet the recovery is capped by a 25% collapse in North American EV sales and persistent Chinese overcapacity, creating a two-speed market. Analysts argue the split between stationary storage and transport end-markets is forcing a fundamental re-evaluation of how to value lithium developers.
